macros.name: aaz
macros.doc: The \aaz command outputs “a” or “az”, depending on the argument.

macros.name: Aaz
macros.doc: The \Aaz command outputs “A” or “Az”, depending on the argument.

macros.name: aazx
macros.doc: The \aazx command is the extended version of \aaz taking 3 parameters: the second and third parameters will be put in the output before and after the reference.

macros.name: Aazx
macros.doc: The equivalent of \aazx for the beginning of a sentence.
